court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Mr. Siddharth S/O Saoji Urkude vs Mrs. Sheetal Siddharth Urkude
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2009. The husband alleged cruelty by the wife and sought maintenance for himself and their children. The trial court allowed the wife's maintenance application.

legal_principles.principle: A husband or wife would be entitled to dissolution of marriage by decree of divorce if the cruelty is proved.
legal_principles.held: The mental cruelty and its effect varies from individual to individual, from society to society and also depends on the status of the persons.
cited_cases: Dr. (Mrs.) Malathi Ravi Vs. Dr. B.V. Ravi (2014) 6 ALL MR 400 (S.C.), Mrs. Christine lazarus Menezes Vs. Mr. lazarus Peter Menezes 2017 (2) DMC 363

legal_principles.principle: The principle is that the marriage is a social institution.
legal_principles.held: A husband or wife would be entitled to dissolution of marriage by decree of divorce if the cruelty is proved.
cited_cases: Dr. (Mrs.) Malathi Ravi Vs. Dr. B.V. Ravi (2014) 6 ALL MR 400 (S.C.), Mrs. Christine lazarus Menezes Vs. Mr. lazarus Peter Menezes 2017 (2) DMC 363

outcome.final_order: The final order granted maintenance of Rs.4000/- per month to the respondent/wife and Rs.2000/- per month to each children.
